_about: WORDS THREE, HIS HOMEWORK, SHEET SEVEN: OUR TRY ON EVERY CARD, WAITING BEHIND SHEET SIX (VAMILY rules 467 amended, 470(g), 465; ask rows 629, 666). He answered 41 cards in one sitting, so two sheets wait at once. The same law as sheet six: our try in the voice beside the line the game says now, at least two in three cursing in full, the clean ones saying why, never 'it pays'. Here: 10 of 12 curse; the memorial post and the woman of the soup line are clean on purpose. Our tries are on the cards only: nothing in the game is rewritten until he says he is done (rule 465).
said: you show me one sentence or one dialog caption that you made and then I'll tell you how I want that shit to sound

cards.rule: MOST PEOPLE CURSE: a post about somebody missing
cards.who_plain: A grandmother in the valley whose brother never came back
cards.when: her brother has been gone four days
cards.try: has anybody seen my brother Ernesto?? went to the depot to trade a radio 4 days ago and never came back. please. i'm losing my shit
cards.teaches: A POST ABOUT SOMEBODY MISSING: your insulin post was 'SOS'; our try is typed scared, with a curse

cards.rule: WHERE THE CURSING STOPS: a memorial post
cards.who_plain: A man in the valley posting that an old neighbour died
cards.when: the old man who wound the church clock died in the night
cards.try: Tommy Reyes passed last night. 81. wound the church clock every sunday for twenty years. who's gonna wind it now
cards.clean: a memorial for an old man; grief that quiet does not curse
cards.teaches: GRIEF ON THE FEED: our try stays clean on purpose and plainer; is a memorial where the cursing stops

cards.rule: MOST PEOPLE CURSE: a kid's first hit
cards.where: in a FIGHT, over his head
cards.try: I fucking got him! Did you see that?!
cards.teaches: A KID'S HIT: his kill stayed clean ('Okay. Okay. That's real.', your YES); his hit, the happy one, curses in our try

cards.rule: PLAIN BEATS CLEVER, AND THEY CURSE: running away
cards.when: you ran from a fight and got away
cards.where: on the screen after a FIGHT you ran from
cards.try: We didn't run, we got the fuck out. There's a difference.
cards.teaches: A RETREAT: ours is a quip ('We relocated. Loudly.'); our try says it plain and curses

cards.rule: MOST PEOPLE CURSE: waking up after everybody went down
cards.who_plain: The biggest man in your crew
cards.when: the whole crew went down and somebody dragged you all out
cards.where: on the screen after a FIGHT you lost to the last man
cards.try: Ruiz did this. I'm gonna find that motherfucker and every one of his boys.
cards.teaches: THE WORST LOSS: every man down, and the game puts in the name of who did it; our try names him and curses him

cards.rule: MOST PEOPLE CURSE: an old soldier selling himself
cards.who_plain: An old Guard sergeant whose pension died with the dollar
cards.when: you look at him in the hire line
cards.where: in a TOWN, on the card of a man for hire
cards.try: Two tours and a pension, and the fucking pension died first. Point me where you want me.
cards.teaches: A HIRE WHO WAS CHEATED: the pension died with the dollar; our try lets him be bitter

cards.rule: NEVER 'IT PAYS', AND WHO DOES NOT CURSE: the woman who feeds the hungry
cards.mouth: A JOB GIVER AT THE BOARD
cards.who_plain: The woman who runs the soup line
cards.when: you ask what her job is and what you get for it
cards.where: in a camp or TOWN, at the board where people offer jobs
cards.try: That motel by the freeway was ours. Beds for the soup line. A crew took it, and now the hungry pay at the door. Clear them out and I'll give you {pay} batteries, everything the kitchen saved.
cards.clean: the woman who runs the soup line, asking for the hungry; she does not curse
cards.teaches: WHO PAYS, SAID BY THE ONE WHO PAYS: the kitchen's savings; and a woman of the soup line left clean on purpose

cards.rule: MOST PEOPLE CURSE: an old woman in pain
cards.who_plain: An old woman with her jaw tied up in a scarf
cards.when: she stops you to send you after the boss who owns the only dentist's kit
cards.where: on the MAP, on the card that starts a boss's trail
cards.try: My tooth. Three weeks, and it's killing me. THE TOOTH has the only kit that works, and his men sit at the town gates taking batteries off everybody. Find that son of a bitch. His flyers are up by the clinics.
cards.teaches: AN OLD WOMAN WHO CURSES: your starred old woman did not; three weeks of a rotten tooth might; and our try drops 'Ay, mijo'

cards.rule: MOST PEOPLE CURSE: the radio as they come up the ladder
cards.who_plain: The guard at a town's gate, on the radio
cards.when: the men who took the gate are climbing to the roof
cards.where: on the phone's FEED, while the town falls
cards.try: They're coming up the fucking ladder. I heard two shots. Oh shit. Oh shit.
cards.teaches: THE RADIO AT THE WORST SECOND: the church radio stays clean in our tries; this town's guard is past praying

cards.rule: MOST PEOPLE CURSE: his man, why the animals come
cards.mouth: YOUR MAN, BEFORE A FIGHT WITH ANIMALS
cards.role: says why the animals are coming
cards.when: animals come at the cart for the food on it
cards.where: on the card that opens a FIGHT
cards.try: They smell the food in our cart, boss, and those hungry fuckers want it.
cards.teaches: THE WHY LINE FROM HIS OWN MAN: your YES on 'they just come' was clean; this one curses in our try

cards.rule: A THING TOLD BECOMES A PERSON SAYING IT: after you dig a girl out
cards.mouth: A ROAD STOP: WHAT COMES BACK
cards.role: the card answers after you pick 'Dig her out.'
cards.who_plain: Nobody: the card itself, after you dug the girl out of the drain
cards.when: you dug her out before the rain came
cards.where: on the MAP, on the road card, after you pick
cards.try: She ran home without even saying thanks. Don't worry, the whole damn town already knows it was you who dug her out.
cards.teaches: YOUR 'FUCKING COOKIE' LESSON: a told line after a choice becomes somebody talking; our try says it as a person and curses

cards.rule: SAY IT LIKE A PERSON, AND THEY CURSE: a doctor on what people did
cards.mouth: A SIDE QUEST ON THE ROAD
cards.who_plain: A doctor outside her clinic tent, smoking
cards.when: she tells you how the two families will settle it
cards.where: on the MAP, on a side quest's last card
cards.try: In front of both families. They'll vote like it's fair, and every one of them goes home knowing exactly what the fuck they voted for.
cards.teaches: A DOCTOR WHO HAS SEEN TOO MUCH: your doc said 'pus bomb' and stayed clean; this one is bitter, smoking, and curses in our try
